description.value: Osetra Coastal Cuisine is a contemporary seafood restaurant in downtown Vancouver, known for precision sourcing and an elevated atmosphere. The menu spans caviar service, Dungeness crab cake, house-cured King Salmon, and a weekend brunch, all presented under the banner of 'The Key Collection.' Indoor and outdoor seating are available and the venue is wheelchair accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at osetravancouver.com is fully accessible and confirms the address (410 West Georgia Street, Vancouver, BC) and phone (778-239-4203) matching OSM tags. The site presents an active, contemporary seafood restaurant with brunch, dinner, and private events offerings. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all amenity fields default to null. One notable discrepancy: OSM spells the name 'Ostera' while the website consistently uses 'OSETRA' — this is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name spelling mismatch: OSM records the name as 'Ostera Coastal Cuisine' but the website consistently uses 'OSETRA COASTAL CUISINE' — the OSM record likely contains a typo and should be corrected to 'Osetra Coastal Cuisine'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a live website, confirmed address and phone, and current menus. A touring cyclist stopping in downtown Vancouver may find this a useful dining option.
